snippet.title: Robomaze
snippet.description:
The original Robomaze, part one of four games.

1. Robomaze (later subtitled "The Basement")
2. Robomaze II: The Tower
3. Robomaze III: The Dome
4. Robomaze III: The Final Journey

"The Dome" was the shareware version of part 3 and loosely ties directly into "The Final Journey" (hence forth TFJ) in a way that doesn't make much sense.  It's best to think of it as a gameplay demo, of the latter game, which was available by mail-order.  I'm not sure how it was originally distributed, but Robomaze 1 came free with TFJ.
